topic: How to Wash Microfiber Cloths Without Ruining Them
notes: Do not treat all microfiber products as identical. Use the product care label as the controlling instruction because wash temperature, bleach compatibility and dryer suitability vary by product. The guide may explain that manufacturer instructions differ even among microfiber cloths, so generic advice should stay conservative and label-first.

sources.title: Clothes Captioning: Complying with the Care Labeling Rule
